subject: Commercial acceptance checklist & escrow conditions
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@olivetech.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Commercial acceptance checklist & escrow conditions

Sarah / Procurement team —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Attached is an updated Mutual Action Plan (Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf) and a first-pass SOW (SOW_draft_OLV_v1.docx). Key items for us to confirm before commercial sign:

- Checkpoint triggers: proof-of-concept KPI (week 4), performance acceptance (week 8), and ramp-to-commit (month 3)
- Pricing cadence: list + committed tier + staged discounts at each checkpoint (we've left placeholders in the pricing workbook)
- Escrow conditions: proposed clause that releases a portion of the holdback once performance acceptance is signed
- Evidence: SOC2 report access, retention policy, and deployment attestation — we can provide this by EOD Wednesday if helpful

As a next step, can you confirm whether OliveTech requires escrow to be tied to the week-8 acceptance milestone versus the month-3 ramp? Also please flag any SOW redlines so Marissa and I can iterate quickly. If you prefer, we can get the legal teams on a short call tomorrow.

Thanks,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_MAP_v3.pdf (MAP), SOW_draft_OLV_v1.docx (SOW), pricing-model-breakdown.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@olivetech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Cc: OliveTech Legal <legal@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 09 Aug 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial acceptance checklist & escrow conditions

Jordan —

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the clear MAP. A few quick points from procurement and legal:

1) Escrow timing: Our procurement lead prefers the escrow release at the performance acceptance (week 8) rather than month 3 — we need evidence the model meets the agreed latency and quality KPIs at that point.
2) Ramp discounts: we like staged incentives, but we need the discount schedule to be tied to committed RPS (requests/sec) not just duration. Can you map the proposed discounts to committed throughput buckets?
3) Evidence: legal will need SOC2 + data flow diagram; procurement will accept a redacted SOC2 if full report is not sharable.

If you can send a clean SOW with the escrow language and a pricing table mapped to throughput buckets, I can route to Legal this afternoon. Otherwise, let's do a short call tomorrow at 10am PT.

Best,
Sarah Nguyen
Head of Procurement, OliveTech
sarah.nguyen@olivetech.com

Cc: Sarah Nguyen <sarah.nguyen@olivetech.com>, procurement@olivetech.com
Date: Tue, 10 Aug 2027 08:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial acceptance checklist & escrow conditions

Jordan / Ben —

Looping in suggested commercial language based on OliveTech's ask (see inline below). High level proposal we should offer:

- Escrow release tied to Performance Acceptance (week 8). Release 50% of escrow on signed acceptance; remaining 50% on ramp-to-commit (month 3).
- Discount schedule mapped to committed throughput buckets:
  * Tier A: >=10k RPS - 12% discount after week 8 acceptance
  * Tier B: 5k-9,999 RPS - 8% discount after month 3 ramp
  * Tier C: <5k RPS - 4% discount (no further escalation)
- Short stop-gap: if SOC2 cannot be shared, provide a redacted report + attestation letter from our security team within 48 hours.

I've attached a redline to the SOW and a suggested escrow paragraph (will send as SOW_draft_OLV_v1_redline.docx). We should keep commercial concessions conservative — OliveTech is strategic but they are asking for multiple conditional releases. Ben, can you weigh in on whether the 12% top-tier discount is acceptable vs. a stepped 10/8/5 approach?

Jordan — please prep a pricing table mapped to RPS buckets so Sarah/procurement can route quickly to Legal. If they approve escrow at week 8 we can shorten the DocuSign cycle.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Date: Wed, 11 Aug 2027 16:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Commercial acceptance checklist & escrow conditions — proposed final

Sarah / OliveTech team —

Thanks for the clear guidance. We discussed internally and can sign off on the following streamlined commercial MAP:

1) Checkpoints & escrow: Performance Acceptance (week 8) triggers 50% release of escrow; month-3 ramp triggers remainder.
2) Discount schedule (applied retroactively to the month where committed RPS is hit):
   - Tier A (>=10k RPS): 10% discount after week 8; additional 2% after month 3 if ramp holds
   - Tier B (5k-9,999 RPS): 7% discount after month 3
   - Tier C (<5k RPS): 4% discount (no further escalations)
3) Evidence: We will provide a redacted SOC2 + security attestation within 48 hours and a deployment runbook to Legal for review.

I've attached the redlined SOW and an updated pricing table. If OliveTech is aligned, we'll publish a final SOW and MAP and push the package to DocuSign (link below) for signatures. Please reply with approval or final minor redlines by end-of-business Friday so we can meet the proposed onboarding timeline.

DocuSign (embedded): https://docusign.com/embedded/sign/abc123def
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/OLV-2027-042

Appreciate the collaborative process — happy to jump on a 15-minute call if that helps close the last few items.

Regards,
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Sales, Redwood Inference
